name: Zod Engine
description:
The Zod Engine is an open-source multiplayer remake of Z (1996), the classic real-time tactical strategy game developed by The Bitmap Brothers. It modernizes the territory-conquering robotic war for modern systems.

Features:
- Native cross-platform execution with support for high resolutions and modern displays
- Tactical real-time strategy gameplay focused on territory control, factories, and flags
- Robust multiplayer support for online and LAN battles against human opponents
- Challenging AI opponents for intense single-player skirmish matches
- Faithful recreation of original robot units, tanks, gun emplacements, and humorous cutscenes
